description: AccelerANTgine's Renovate config. Everything shared lives in the preset at ContainerHub's repository root (default.json); the `extends` line below is the whole adoption, exactly as in the four top-level consumers.

The part this repo cannot get any other way is the git-submodules manager, which Renovate DISABLES by default. third_party/ContainerHub is where this repo's code-quality and coverage libraries come from, and it had drifted 54 commits behind before 2026-09-09 with nothing to notice -- no gate in the family checks gitlink freshness.

This repo had NO dependency bot of any kind before this file: no renovate.json and no dependabot.yml. So unlike the other consumers there is no hand-over to sequence and nothing to delete afterwards; this is a pure addition.

Renovate resolves `github>Kataglyphis/ContainerHub` from ContainerHub's DEFAULT BRANCH, not from the pin in third_party/ContainerHub, so a preset change reaches this repo only after it is merged there. And the Renovate GitHub App is NOT installed on this repository and will not be (owner decision, 2026-09-09) -- no bot will ever author a commit here. That does not make this file idle: the local CLI reads exactly it. See third_party/ContainerHub/docs/dependency-updates.md.
